build_spec.purpose: Automate accounts payable processes, including invoice processing, payment processing, and vendor management

core_capabilities.description: Extract relevant information from invoices, such as vendor name, invoice number, and amount due
Generate payments to vendors based on approved invoices and payment terms
Maintain a database of vendors, including contact information and payment history

workflow_steps.detail: Receive and extract relevant information from invoices
Route invoices for approval based on predefined rules and workflows
Generate payments to vendors based on approved invoices and payment terms

integrations.purpose: Integrate with ERP system to retrieve vendor information and update payment history
Integrate with banking system to generate payments to vendors

suggested_tech_stack.orchestration: Workflow management tool, such as Apache Airflow or Zapier
suggested_tech_stack.database: Relational database management system, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL
integrations: APIs for ERP and banking systems

build_spec.what_competitors_have: Basic invoice processing and payment processing capabilities
build_spec.our_differentiation: Advanced workflow management and vendor management capabilities, as well as integration with ERP and banking systems

competitor_summary.others: HighRadius offers autonomous finance solutions for accounts payable, but with limited workflow management and vendor management capabilities
